step.name: Create the Sheet
step.text: Open Google Sheets, create a new spreadsheet, name the tab Submissions, and add column headers in row 1 that match the name attributes on your HTML form inputs.

step.name: Open Apps Script and paste the doPost function
step.text: Inside the Sheet, open Extensions then Apps Script. Paste the doPost script provided in this guide. Save the project.

step.name: Run initialSetup and deploy the web app
step.text: Pick initialSetup in the function dropdown and click Run. Approve the OAuth prompt. Click Deploy, New deployment, Web app, Execute as Me, Anyone has access. Copy the deployment URL.

step.name: Wire the deployment URL into your HTML form
step.text: Point your form's fetch endpoint or action attribute at the deployment URL. Submit a test entry. The row appears in the Sheet within a second.

mainEntity.name: Is it really free to send HTML form data to Google Sheets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Google Apps Script is free with any Google account, capped at one Sheets write per second per user. Google Forms is free. Formester's free plan covers 100 submissions a month.

mainEntity.name: How secure is form data in Google Sheets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google encrypts data at rest and in transit. Lock sharing to specific accounts, neutralize formula characters on input to prevent CSV injection, and do not use a Sheet for payment data or passwords.

mainEntity.name: What is the rate limit on Apps Script writes to Sheets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Roughly 100 requests per 100 seconds per user, per Google's published quotas. A contact form sustaining one submission per second sits comfortably inside that envelope.

mainEntity.name: Can I send file uploads from the form into Google Sheets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sheets cannot hold a file. Write the file to Google Drive via Apps Script and store the Drive URL in the cell, or use a no-code builder that handles file uploads natively.

mainEntity.name: How do I add CAPTCHA or spam protection?

acceptedAnswer.text: The script in this guide ships a honeypot field. For more, add Google reCAPTCHA v3 on the client and verify the token server-side before writing to the Sheet.

mainEntity.name: How do I get an email when someone submits the form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MailApp.sendEmail inside the doPost function in Apps Script. Or use the autoresponder feature in a no-code builder and skip the code.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this on Netlify, Vercel, or any static site?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Apps Script deployment URL is a fetch target. It works from any frontend, hosted anywhere, with no backend on your side.

mainEntity.name: Can I move from this setup to a database later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Easily. Sheets is a great starter store. When you cross a few hundred submissions a week, route the same form to a database or CRM in parallel with the Sheet.
